title: 冬支度と年の瀬
lead: 冬支度・餅つき・冬至・大掃除・大みそかなど、11月から12月の暮らしの素材12点です。おたよりや年末の案内に使えます。
subject_en: Flat illustration of late-autumn to year-end items, each ONE object or small scene centred, warm colours. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a heater, a blanket and a thick sweater
two people pounding rice cake with a mallet and a mortar
yuzu fruits floating in a bath tub
a simmered kabocha pumpkin in a bowl
a bucket, a mop and a duster
a bowl of soba noodles with shrimp tempura
a temple bell at night with snow
a stack of postcards and a brush pen
a kagami-mochi with a bitter orange on top
